commits.message:
fix(rule)!: a title wider than the rule is cut with an ellipsis, as Rich's is (rich-rule-thri) (#317)

* fix(rule)!: a title wider than the rule is cut with an ellipsis between rule cells, as Rich's is (rich-rule-thri)

Rule now lays its line out as Rich's __rich_console__ does: the title is cut
to the width less Rich's required_space (4 centred, 2 aligned) with an
ellipsis, a rule cell stays either side, and a rule with no room past that
is bare. A left- or right-aligned title no longer carries a space on its
closed side.

The ellipsis cut Panel already ported from Rich's Text.truncate is now
cutLabel in embed.ts, shared by both; the space either side of a label is
Panel's _title padding and moves to Panel.

* fix(embed): a cut label's ellipsis and split-cell pad keep the label's spans, as Rich's Text.truncate does (rich-rule-thri)
